caption: The drawing features a horizontal rectangular band centered on a plain beige background. The band contains a geometric pattern with a repeated green Greek key (meander) design outlined in dark red, set on a teal background. At the very top and bottom of the band, there are dark red borders containing alternating circles or dots in a slightly lighter red shade. Slightly off-center to the right along the bottom edge, there is a small decorative circular motif composed of teal and red dots arranged in a ring. Below the band, toward the bottom right of the image, the name “S. Liswood” is written in thin, neat, black handwriting.
title: Wallpaper Border
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
